name: ai-teach-me
description: Stop coding blind with AI: every technology Claude proposes and you adopt gets a Markdown learning note (key concepts, pitfalls, alternatives, official docs) in your personal knowledgebase.

notes_dir.title: Knowledge base folder
notes_dir.description: Full path of the folder where your technology notes are stored. Leave empty to create it in your Documents folder (macOS/Windows: ~/Documents, Linux: your XDG Documents folder) under the name below. Created on first use.

kb_folder_name.title: Knowledge base folder name
kb_folder_name.description: Name of the folder created in Documents when the path above is empty. One word, no slashes.
